notes.title: I Know What You Fixed Last Summer
notes.content:
Yikes, sorry about that title. I should have gone with [i]Ghost In The Shell Script[/i]. Actually, shh, forget I said that, I'll use it another time.

Ok here's whats new!

- Not a lot.

- New Autosave in Day 5 (at the start of the third/final round of questioning) (did you know Day 5 is a murder mystery?! because it [i]so[/i] is.)

- Cleaned up some code in Day 5 that prevents a rare issue when questioning Pendleton (thank you PsyD Mom!)

- One time, the word Irish was said and it wasn't capitalized. So. Now it is.

- Another time, there was an extra "a" in a sentence. And now it's not.

Oh! Something fun! There's a super cool Player's Guide/Companion to all the must-see moments in the game and it's now included in the PC version's game folder! It can also be found on the website:

[url=https://thephantomfellows.com/companion]Player’s Guide- Can’t-Miss Companion to The Phantom Fellows[/url]

Also, while I strongly recommend you instead use the in-game hint system, there is an [url=https://thephantomfellows.com/walkthrough]official walkthrough[/url] on the website as well!

Finally, if you enjoyed your time with my game and haven't already, I'd greatly appreciate a positive review, it really helps out a solo dev like myself :)

And as always, thank you for playing [i]The Phantom Fellows[/i]!

notes.title: Ghost Portraits by Olan Mills
notes.content:
Are we... did that Olan Mills reference land? Here, I'll explain it into being funny, see they were the quintessential 80's family portrait people and this build has [b]all new ghost portraits[/b] so that's why, well, that's the why.

I regret going this route.

But I'd hate to waste a whole, terrible paragraph so on with the show!

- Fixed an uncommon bug in Day 4 that caused a crash 

- Fixed a single spelling error (I'llll never tell) (teehee)

- Sorry about that teehee up there

- Intro music over the menu lowered [i]yet again[/i] I think I've lowered it a few in every single update and it was still a little loud for streamers 

- Added more direction and clarity to the opening dialog in Day 5, should a player try to leave before briefing is completed

- Finally, the ghost's have new portraits and I think they look ah-mazing, shek 'em out!

And as always, thank you for playing ([u]and leaving a positive review for[/u]) [i]The Phantom Fellows[/i]!

notes.title: Reviewers and Early Access Players (Only): Switch Builds to Maintain Saves!
notes.content:
Hello reviewers! Thank you for playing The Phantom Fellows early!  

To maintain your save state after early access, please follow these steps to switch builds:
1. Open your Steam Library.
2. Right-click on [i]The Phantom Fellows[/i] and select Properties.
3. Go to the Betas tab.
4. In the dropdown, select the build labeled "[b]review_build[/b]" to continue with your saved progress.

This will allow you to seamlessly continue playing without losing any progress. If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out for support.
Thank you again for your feedback and for playing [i]The Phantom Fellows[/i]!

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
Launching September 27th 2024 for PC, Mac & Linux!

They say it takes a village and as a solo dev and solo dad, I am so grateful for your support through this journey. I have had the best 3.5 years of my life making this game and I'm so excited to share it with you!

 🤍 Paul

notes.title: The Phantom Fellows Releasing in 2024!
notes.content:
Fellow Adventurers! 

Hi! Hey. Sup. Starting this with Fellow Adventurers gives this whole thing a real hear ye hear ye vibe, right? Like now I don't know how to frame this, it's all suddenly very Monty Python-y in my head. Okay look, listen, let's not make this a whole thing, just, here's a quick update:

I'm almost done, omg this was kinda hard.

But also, I gave the artwork quite a massive overhaul a few months ago, maybe it was a year now, doesn't matter, and so the original demo now makes me sad to look at. The original demo is like my game's awkward puberty stage and now I want all pics of it removed from the internet. So, at the end of January (2024) I will be releasing an updated Demo, featuring all the new art and the new UI and just, all the new everything.

Okay demo portion covered, SHEK. 

On to the full release! First of all, gross, hate that wording. Next of all, the full game is about to enter public beta testing! While it's being tested and fixed, and tested and fixed, I will also be creating and recording the soundtrack. I have no firm idea of when it'll be done and while this was kind of a 'on the DL' thought, if you're reading this, you deserve to know, I'm hoping to have the game ready for the Adventure Game Hotspot Fan Fair, this summer. For reasons. Possibly related to being in the Adventure Game Hotspot Network and wanting to bring some show n tell with me to the, the thing. The convention. Also come to the convention, it's gonna be rad.

Ok I'm all done, thanks for reading this, please tell people about it or retweet stuff or like, I don't know, drink more water? Okay good talk. 

I hope you're all doing well, I love you, don't do a mur- oh wait, wrong, that's a different thing.

🤍 Paul

notes.title: The Phantom Fellows Release Update
notes.content:
Fellow adventurers! Ok and please don't yell at me but, I'm delaying the release date. But don't mourn the delay, celebrate the reason or whatever because the truth is, it came down to- make a ton of sacrifices for the sake of not having to write this, or, hold firm and release the best possible game I can make. And I love this game, I've been working on it full time for almost 3 years now and these have been the best 3 years of my life. I cannot wait to share this with you and with your support, I'll continue to give this everything I have!

This is the best community on the planet, thank you for your motivating and relentless kindness 

💙 Paul

Also, Spring ish, 2023
